About Zego 🚀
Insurance hasn't changed much in over a century. The way we live, work and travel has.
Good drivers are the entire point of Zego. Seven in 10 drivers on the road are consistently good, but until telematics came along there was no way to prove it, so nearly everyone paid a price based on averages. Zego is the company built to change that.
We're leading the AI evolution in insurance 🤖
We move fast, without the layers that usually slow things down. AI takes the routine work off every team, from Finance to Product to Marketing, so people ship real code and launch custom dashboards in minutes.

Engineering commits are entirely AI-assisted, which shifts the focus from team size to the quality of your thinking, and our data warehouse connects directly to an AI assistant for instant answers.

Backed by a modern tech stack (Claude Code, Snowflake, Figma and Zapier) and a commitment to adopting new tools in days rather than quarters, you get complete ownership to do the most impactful work of your career.
Do not take our word for it. Read what Zegons say about us on Glassdoor .

We're not hiring at all costs, we're hiring the right people, at pace. Working smarter with AI – improving outreach, spotting patterns in pipeline data, and finding efficiencies wherever they exist

What you'll need to be successful
You know tech hiring. At least two years of sourcing experience, with a strong track record in Software Engineering and Data roles – Senior Software Engineers, Engineering Managers, full-stack profiles
You work at pace. You've recruited in a start-up or scale-up environment and you're comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities
You know your tools. You're confident using LinkedIn Recruiter and Juicebox, and you actively look for better ways to use them
You're into AI. You're actively curious about how AI can enhance your work – keen to experiment, learn quickly, and apply tools that improve productivity or unlock new ways of thinking. Whether you're already hands-on or fast building confidence, you take ownership of staying ahead
You make a strong first impression. Candidates will meet Zego through you first. You write well, communicate clearly, and know how to spark a conversation
You deliver with consistency. You take pride in doing the detail well – thorough notes, clean handovers, and a process the team can rely on
You measure what matters. You're comfortable with sourcing metrics and use data to improve, not just report

We believe the tools don't make the sourcer, but the right stack helps us move with velocity
Sourcing – LinkedIn Recruiter, Juicebox
ATS – Workable
Collaboration – Notion, Slack, Google Meet

AI & automation – Claude, Gemini, Zapier
The Zego ways of working 🏡
Teams work better with time to collaborate and space to get things done. We call it Zego Hybrid: some of us are in our central London office weekly, others monthly or quarterly. It's about finding the balance between face time and focus that produces great work and a healthy life around it.
We also make a point of getting everyone in the same room. Teams come together every quarter, and once a year the whole company does so properly. It's a serious investment and consistently one of the best parts of the year.

Mit Spitzentechnologie, kreativem Design und höchster Qualität machen wir unsere Kunden zu Fans. An unseren Standorten auf der ganzen Welt ist Teamwork nicht nur ein Begriff, sondern gelebte Firmenkultur. Wir bieten ein Umfeld mit viel Drive in einer motivierenden, respektvollen und freundschaftlichen Atmosphäre.

Möchtest du deine Karriere bei uns ins Rollen bringen?

Nous recherchons une personne fiable, engagée et orientée vers le service, disposant des compétences et qualifications suivantes :
* Expérience en EMS ou en milieu hospitalier fortement recommandée
* Autonomie, sens des responsabilités et respect strict de la confidentialité
* Organisation, esprit d'équipe et capacité à collaborer au sein d'une équipe multidisciplinaire
* Empathie, bienveillance et sens du contact avec les patients
* Intérêt marqué pour la restauration et/ou le domaine hôtelier
* Excellentes aptitudes relationnelles et sens du service
* Esprit d'initiative et capacité d'adaptation

En tant qu'Agent hôtelier, vous intervenez au coeur de la prise en charge quotidienne des patients et contribuez activement à leur confort et à leur bien-être.
